title: A user-friendly tool for cloud-based whole slide image segmentation with examples from renal histopathology
study_context: Renal histological structure segmentation with transfer learning, comparing random initialization, a glomerulus model, GTEx tissue-type pretraining and ImageNet pretraining.
population_or_data: Renal histological structure segmentation with transfer learning, comparing random initialization, a glomerulus model, GTEx tissue-type pretraining and ImageNet pretraining.
task: Renal histological structure segmentation with transfer learning, comparing random initialization, a glomerulus model, GTEx tissue-type pretraining and ImageNet pretraining.
main_findings: A model pretrained on GTEx tissue-type recognition was transferred to renal glomerulus, arteriole and artery segmentation; the paper identifies GTEx WSIs as autopsy tissue.
In the renal vessel-segmentation comparison, GTEx pretraining outperformed random initialization but ImageNet pretraining achieved higher MCC than GTEx for glomeruli, arterioles and arteries.
limitations: Selected-page review only; not a full-paper audit. Text and rendered pages 1, 2, 8, 9 checked on 2026-10-07.

Does not establish benefit for heart-transplant rejection, equivalence between biopsy and autopsy, or an advantage over an already pretrained UNI encoder. GTEx pretraining used multiple organs, not a rejection cohort.
does_not_establish: Does not establish benefit for heart-transplant rejection, equivalence between biopsy and autopsy, or an advantage over an already pretrained UNI encoder. GTEx pretraining used multiple organs, not a rejection cohort.
relevance_to_project: A noncardiac example of autopsy-derived representation pretraining transferred to biopsy histology analysis.
